# QYL0122: No span starter inside an AIFunction

<!-- <auto-generated /> This file is generated by tools/Qyl.Telemetry.SemanticConventions.Analyzers.DocsGenerator. -->

| Property | Value |
| -- | -- |
| Severity | Error |
| Category | `GenAI` |
| Code fix | No |
| Analyzer | `Qyl0122StarterInsideAIFunctionAnalyzer` |
| Enabled by default | Yes |

## Description

FunctionInvokingChatClient records the execute_tool span of every AIFunction it invokes, and the registry says not to record two spans for one tool call. Inside the function, set business keys on Activity.Current with SetAppTag instead.
